prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: original professional game-title logotype, transparent PNG overlay for racing-game promotional banners.
Create ONE finished standalone wordmark for the game whose exact full title is "Formula 2027: Grand Prix Legends".
Displayed lettering must be spelled EXACTLY as follows, in two clearly separated typographic tiers:
Main line: "FORMULA 2027"
Subtitle: "GRAND PRIX LEGENDS"
The colon in the full title is represented by this typographic hierarchy; do not add a colon, slogan or any other wording.
Style: original premium motorsport game identity, bold condensed forward-leaning custom geometric uppercase typography, crisp strong letterforms, subtle purposeful angular cuts, excellent small-size readability. A single coherent title lockup, not a sheet of options. Main line dominant, subtitle smaller but still substantial, with careful generous tracking and centered alignment. Compact wide logo proportions roughly 3:1, comfortably fits both a landscape racing banner and the top of a portrait cover.
Color: FORMULA in bright pearl-white; 2027 in rich vermilion red; GRAND PRIX LEGENDS in pearl-white. A very thin dark navy keyline around the individual letters and a restrained hard offset shadow provide legibility over light or dark racing imagery. Restrained satin edge highlights are acceptable; avoid massive chrome bevels. Small integrated red speed-cut accents may support the lettering, but no separate large symbol.
Quality: precise typography, clean sharp edges, professional optical spacing, clear distinction between the numerals 2, 0, 2 and 7, intact counters and all words fully readable. All lettering and accents fully contained in canvas with at least 5 percent transparent safety margin. Keep the logo large in frame.
BACKGROUND MUST BE GENUINELY TRANSPARENT ALPHA. All empty space around and between the letters must be transparent. No background rectangle, no shield, no badge, no black plate, no scenery, no car, no mockup surface, no baked-in checkerboard pattern, no glow cloud, no surrounding texture.
Do not copy any official Formula One/F1 logo, racing team emblem or Nintendo branding. No extra text, no trademark symbols, no watermark. Produce the isolated final logo only.
